goal: Confirm the repository is healthy, then decide and record what should change next, spending model capability only where deterministic checks cannot decide.
notes: The first two stages are deterministic on purpose: they cost no model tokens and they gate the stages that do.
Capability classes are provider-neutral; the concrete model resolves at run time from configured providers.

stages.goal: Run deterministic repository validation and fail fast on structural or privacy errors.

required_context.task: repository validation errors and project state

validator.description: validate exits non-zero when the repository has structural or privacy errors

stages.stop_condition: validate has exited; do not fix anything in this stage
expected_outputs: validation report with error and warning counts

stages.goal: Run the regression suite so later stages start from a known-good baseline.

required_context.task: regression test suite and validation commands

validator.description: the suite exits non-zero on any failure

stages.stop_condition: the suite has finished; do not change code in this stage
expected_outputs: test run result with pass and failure counts

stages.goal: Read the open improvement candidates and the latest handoff, and name the single highest-value next change with its evidence.
artifacts: a ranked shortlist with one recommended change

required_context.task: open improvements, recent decisions, and remaining work

validator.description: the stage must name a recommended change and cite its evidence

stages.stop_condition: one recommended change is named with evidence; do not implement it

stages.goal: Capture the recommendation as an improvement candidate and a compact handoff, so the decision survives this session.

validator.description: captured records must leave the repository valid

stages.stop_condition: the candidate and handoff exist and validate; nothing is promoted to canonical memory
